# Whole objects, compared by tools/mc-diff/canon.sh: each reference form
# through each kind of symbol. GNU as relocates every reference from code on
# this target, even to the label before it, and names a code label itself
# rather than its section.
#
# Three things GNU as does that rsasm does not copy are kept out, none of
# which changes what a linker makes of the object:
#
# - the addend of the last R_MSP430_SYM_DIFF in a section, which GNU as
#   writes as the subtrahend's negated value where it writes zero for every
#   other, so a difference is never the last relocation in a section here;
# - where a `.section .data` directive, which refers to `__crt0_movedata` as
#   it is read, falls among the undefined symbols, since rsasm orders those
#   by where they are relocated;
# - a number `.set` after the code that uses it, which GNU as relocates
#   against the symbol and rsasm writes into the field.
=== an undefined symbol
        .text
        jump    X
        beq     X
        bne     X
        blt     X
        bltu    X
        bge     X
        bgeu    X
        bltn    X
        bgt     X
        bgtu    X
        bleu    X
        ble     X

=== a local label in the same section
        .text
        jump    X
        beq     X
        bne     X
        blt     X
        bltu    X
        bge     X
        bgeu    X
        bltn    X
        bgt     X
        bgtu    X
        bleu    X
        ble     X
X:      nop

=== a local label earlier in the section
        .text
X:      nop
        jump    X
        beq     X
        bne     X
        blt     X
        bltu    X
        bge     X
        bgeu    X
        bltn    X
        bgt     X
        bgtu    X
        bleu    X
        ble     X

=== a local label in another code section
        .text
        jump    X
        beq     X
        bne     X
        blt     X
        bltu    X
        bge     X
        bgeu    X
        bltn    X
        bgt     X
        bgtu    X
        bleu    X
        ble     X
        .section .text.other, "ax"
X:      nop

=== a local label in a data section
        .text
        jump    X
        beq     X
        bne     X
        blt     X
        bltu    X
        bge     X
        bgeu    X
        bltn    X
        bgt     X
        bgtu    X
        bleu    X
        ble     X
        .data
        .word 0
X:      .word 1

=== a local label in .bss
        .text
        jump    X
        beq     X
        bne     X
        blt     X
        bltu    X
        bge     X
        bgeu    X
        bltn    X
        bgt     X
        bgtu    X
        bleu    X
        ble     X
        .bss
        .space 2
X:      .space 2

=== a global label in the same section
        .text
        .globl  X
        jump    X
        beq     X
        bne     X
        blt     X
        bltu    X
        bge     X
        bgeu    X
        bltn    X
        bgt     X
        bgtu    X
        bleu    X
        ble     X
X:      nop

=== a global label in a data section
        .text
        .globl  X
        jump    X
        beq     X
        bne     X
        blt     X
        bltu    X
        bge     X
        bgeu    X
        bltn    X
        bgt     X
        bgtu    X
        bleu    X
        ble     X
        .data
X:      .word 1

=== a weak label
        .text
        .weak   X
        jump    X
        beq     X
        bne     X
        blt     X
        bltu    X
        bge     X
        bgeu    X
        bltn    X
        bgt     X
        bgtu    X
        bleu    X
        ble     X
X:      nop

=== a weak undefined symbol
        .text
        .weak   X
        jump    X
        beq     X
        bne     X
        blt     X
        bltu    X
        bge     X
        bgeu    X
        bltn    X
        bgt     X
        bgtu    X
        bleu    X
        ble     X

=== a hidden global label

        .globl  X
        .hidden X

        beq     X
        bne     X
        blt     X
        bltu    X
        bge     X
        bgeu    X

        bgt     X
        bgtu    X
        bleu    X
        ble     X
X:      nop

=== a protected global label

        .protected X

        bgeu    X

=== a local alias of a global label
        .text
        .globl  G
        .set    X, G
        jump    X
        beq     X
        bne     X
        blt     X
        bltu    X
        bge     X
        bgeu    X
        bltn    X
        bgt     X
        bgtu    X
        bleu    X
        ble     X
G:      nop

=== a global alias of a local label
        .text
        .globl  X
        .set    X, L
        jump    X
        beq     X
        bne     X
        blt     X
        bltu    X
        bge     X
        bgeu    X
        bltn    X
        bgt     X
        bgtu    X
        bleu    X
        ble     X
L:      nop

=== a label made global after use
        .text
        jump    X
        beq     X
        bne     X
        blt     X
        bltu    X
        bge     X
        bgeu    X
        bltn    X
        bgt     X
        bgtu    X
        bleu    X
        ble     X
        .globl  X
X:      nop
